about_the_game: A 2.5D game where your hero has 4 powerful skills. Your hero can be equipped with weapons, weapons have properties, click on the right side of the four buttons to use different magic, click again to cancel the use of magic, you can also click on the w, a, s, d shortcut keys to use magic. Click on the bottom 4 icons to open the Warehousing dialog box, Equipment dialog box, Weapons synthesis dialog box, click on the storehouse of equipment can be moved to the synthesis dialog box, Equipment dialog box, click on the equipment to move to the dialog box discarded, Weapons synthesis dialog box can be four weapons into a new weapon. Your hero gains levels by defeating enemies, be careful when enemy demons are nearby, ordinary monsters surround you. You need to protect your main building from being defeated and you can save your game progress. The demo version can play at most the first level.
